Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The InformationExtraction_Expert made a mistake in the very first step by failing to properly identify and utilize a more effective search strategy or alternative resources when the initial search on Arxiv did not yield results. They repeatedly used similar search queries and approaches without adapting sufficiently to the problem at hand. For example, they could have considered alternative databases, external resources, or cross-referenced author names from known papers to refine the search. This lack of adaptability and exploration of alternative methods directly contributed to the failure to retrieve the necessary papers and calculate the required time span difference.
